root_admission.decision_basis: Consolidate15 distinct already-computed fixed D50 top-only physical electrode geometries, preserving raw-voltage and separate current/power/joint8 comparisons. Rank provisionally by minimum4 baseline-relative target absolute mean/P10 and target-to-surface/offtarget ratios, retain B0 and8/12/16 pads, never replace unresolved convergence or SC hotpots with a success claim. Compute only cachedfield visualization and600 unloaded potential-difference probes, no repeated PDE/angular scan. Local reported two-case data remain unranked pending original electrical inputs and native artifacts.

spec.rank_definition: For each of four separate normalizations: minimum of targetmean/B0mean, targetP10/B0P10, (targetmean/surfacemean)/(B0targetmean/B0surfacemean), (targetmean/offtargetmean)/(B0targetmean/B0offtargetmean). Display all ratios and absolute values. Primary provisional display order uses joint8 burden comparison, never candidate adoption.
spec.zero_reference_policy: A missing/zero reference makes that ratio and min4 score unavailable; never insert an epsilon or zero-filled result
spec.cutoff_policy: Post-PDE baseline-relative numerical diagnostic values, fixed before this cached classification. No physiological activation or safety threshold.
spec.common_grid_policy: Authenticate original bytes then compare decoded grid and every six original m3 ROI mask arrays exactly across each distinct grid archive; no coordinate index guessing or mask recomputation
spec.alias_policy: Deduplicate exact candidateID+scalarSHA. SameID/differentSHA verification variants remain listed; compare stored scalar arrays without angular reevaluation, use earliest canonical record for display rather than overwrite any result.
spec.probe_policy: Forty unloaded differential predictions per geometry, physical centre/depth/cross coordinates and5mm tip spacing distinct. Same-layer interpolation/extrapolation and nearest-point sensitivity disclosed; ETA5001/DSOX input loading not solved or validated.
spec.local_policy: Reported LOCAL14/LOCAL16 rows are separate fixed-voltage metadata only; native fields, electrical files and burden-normalized comparisons pending unless independently supplied and authenticated. Not ranked alongside native geometries.

probe_prediction.source_basis: 2000Hz output0 and2010Hz output1; caller-supplied actual 1Vpp high-Z solutions

coordinate_system.centre_pattern: Centre plus ±5 mm on x and y at each depth; centre offsets are distinct from 5 mm tip spacing

waveform_window.Vpp_definition: max(real summed carrier waveform)-min over the finite stated samples; sub-sample extrema are not solved

probe_prediction.source_basis: 2000Hz output0 and2010Hz output1; caller-supplied actual 1Vpp high-Z solutions

coordinate_system.centre_pattern: Centre plus ±5 mm on x and y at each depth; centre offsets are distinct from 5 mm tip spacing

waveform_window.Vpp_definition: max(real summed carrier waveform)-min over the finite stated samples; sub-sample extrema are not solved
waveform_window.spectrum_definition: Coherent real-waveform DFT, peak phasor 2*FFT/N at2000/2010Hz; remaining-bin maximum retained
waveform_window.modulation_definition: 2min(abs(delta_phi_2000),abs(delta_phi_2010)); envelope depth, not a physical 10Hz voltage spectral component

instruments.status: User-supplied specifications and ideal gain bookkeeping only; actual settings unconfirmed
instruments.load_interpretation: ETA input specifications preserved as supplied; no input circuit assembled or R/C effects applied. Scope R/C belongs downstream of the active probe output.
instruments.scaling_definition: probe physical output=unloaded tip difference/physical attenuation; displayed voltage=probe output*selected scope display ratio

probe_prediction.interpolation_scope: Physical bilinear XY plus same-layer linear Z; within-layer one-sided extrapolation explicitly labelled and limited to one nearest spacing

waveform_window.Vpp_definition: max(real summed carrier waveform)-min over the finite stated samples; sub-sample extrema are not solved
waveform_window.spectrum_definition: Coherent real-waveform DFT, peak phasor 2*FFT/N at2000/2010Hz; remaining-bin maximum retained
waveform_window.modulation_definition: 2min(abs(delta_phi_2000),abs(delta_phi_2010)); envelope depth, not a physical 10Hz voltage spectral component

instruments.status: User-supplied specifications and ideal gain bookkeeping only; actual settings unconfirmed
instruments.load_interpretation: ETA input specifications preserved as supplied; no input circuit assembled or R/C effects applied. Scope R/C belongs downstream of the active probe output.
instruments.scaling_definition: probe physical output=unloaded tip difference/physical attenuation; displayed voltage=probe output*selected scope display ratio

probe_prediction.interpolation_scope: Physical bilinear XY plus same-layer linear Z; within-layer one-sided extrapolation explicitly labelled and limited to one nearest spacing

probe_prediction.source_basis: 2000Hz output0 and2010Hz output1; caller-supplied actual 1Vpp high-Z solutions

coordinate_system.centre_pattern: Centre plus ±5 mm on x and y at each depth; centre offsets are distinct from 5 mm tip spacing

waveform_window.Vpp_definition: max(real summed carrier waveform)-min over the finite stated samples; sub-sample extrema are not solved
waveform_window.spectrum_definition: Coherent real-waveform DFT, peak phasor 2*FFT/N at2000/2010Hz; remaining-bin maximum retained
waveform_window.modulation_definition: 2min(abs(delta_phi_2000),abs(delta_phi_2010)); envelope depth, not a physical 10Hz voltage spectral component

instruments.status: User-supplied specifications and ideal gain bookkeeping only; actual settings unconfirmed
instruments.load_interpretation: ETA input specifications preserved as supplied; no input circuit assembled or R/C effects applied. Scope R/C belongs downstream of the active probe output.
instruments.scaling_definition: probe physical output=unloaded tip difference/physical attenuation; displayed voltage=probe output*selected scope display ratio

probe_prediction.interpolation_scope: Physical bilinear XY plus same-layer linear Z; within-layer one-sided extrapolation explicitly labelled and limited to one nearest spacing

waveform_window.spectrum_definition: Coherent real-waveform DFT, peak phasor 2*FFT/N at2000/2010Hz; remaining-bin maximum retained
waveform_window.modulation_definition: 2min(abs(delta_phi_2000),abs(delta_phi_2010)); envelope depth, not a physical 10Hz voltage spectral component

instruments.status: User-supplied specifications and ideal gain bookkeeping only; actual settings unconfirmed
instruments.load_interpretation: ETA input specifications preserved as supplied; no input circuit assembled or R/C effects applied. Scope R/C belongs downstream of the active probe output.
instruments.scaling_definition: probe physical output=unloaded tip difference/physical attenuation; displayed voltage=probe output*selected scope display ratio

probe_prediction.interpolation_scope: Physical bilinear XY plus same-layer linear Z; within-layer one-sided extrapolation explicitly labelled and limited to one nearest spacing

coordinate_system.centre_pattern: Centre plus ±5 mm on x and y at each depth; centre offsets are distinct from 5 mm tip spacing

waveform_window.Vpp_definition: max(real summed carrier waveform)-min over the finite stated samples; sub-sample extrema are not solved
waveform_window.spectrum_definition: Coherent real-waveform DFT, peak phasor 2*FFT/N at2000/2010Hz; remaining-bin maximum retained
waveform_window.modulation_definition: 2min(abs(delta_phi_2000),abs(delta_phi_2010)); envelope depth, not a physical 10Hz voltage spectral component

instruments.status: User-supplied specifications and ideal gain bookkeeping only; actual settings unconfirmed
instruments.load_interpretation: ETA input specifications preserved as supplied; no input circuit assembled or R/C effects applied. Scope R/C belongs downstream of the active probe output.
instruments.scaling_definition: probe physical output=unloaded tip difference/physical attenuation; displayed voltage=probe output*selected scope display ratio

probe_prediction.interpolation_scope: Physical bilinear XY plus same-layer linear Z; within-layer one-sided extrapolation explicitly labelled and limited to one nearest spacing

probe_prediction.source_basis: 2000Hz output0 and2010Hz output1; caller-supplied actual 1Vpp high-Z solutions

coordinate_system.centre_pattern: Centre plus ±5 mm on x and y at each depth; centre offsets are distinct from 5 mm tip spacing

waveform_window.Vpp_definition: max(real summed carrier waveform)-min over the finite stated samples; sub-sample extrema are not solved
waveform_window.spectrum_definition: Coherent real-waveform DFT, peak phasor 2*FFT/N at2000/2010Hz; remaining-bin maximum retained
waveform_window.modulation_definition: 2min(abs(delta_phi_2000),abs(delta_phi_2010)); envelope depth, not a physical 10Hz voltage spectral component

instruments.status: User-supplied specifications and ideal gain bookkeeping only; actual settings unconfirmed
instruments.load_interpretation: ETA input specifications preserved as supplied; no input circuit assembled or R/C effects applied. Scope R/C belongs downstream of the active probe output.
instruments.scaling_definition: probe physical output=unloaded tip difference/physical attenuation; displayed voltage=probe output*selected scope display ratio

probe_prediction.interpolation_scope: Physical bilinear XY plus same-layer linear Z; within-layer one-sided extrapolation explicitly labelled and limited to one nearest spacing

provenance.raw_export_source_label: Source that exported stored response; reused old carrier PDE is not counted as a new solve

probe_prediction.source_basis: 2000Hz output0 and2010Hz output1; caller-supplied actual 1Vpp high-Z solutions

coordinate_system.centre_pattern: Centre plus ±5 mm on x and y at each depth; centre offsets are distinct from 5 mm tip spacing

waveform_window.Vpp_definition: max(real summed carrier waveform)-min over the finite stated samples; sub-sample extrema are not solved
waveform_window.spectrum_definition: Coherent real-waveform DFT, peak phasor 2*FFT/N at2000/2010Hz; remaining-bin maximum retained
waveform_window.modulation_definition: 2min(abs(delta_phi_2000),abs(delta_phi_2010)); envelope depth, not a physical 10Hz voltage spectral component

instruments.status: User-supplied specifications and ideal gain bookkeeping only; actual settings unconfirmed
instruments.load_interpretation: ETA input specifications preserved as supplied; no input circuit assembled or R/C effects applied. Scope R/C belongs downstream of the active probe output.
instruments.scaling_definition: probe physical output=unloaded tip difference/physical attenuation; displayed voltage=probe output*selected scope display ratio

probe_prediction.interpolation_scope: Physical bilinear XY plus same-layer linear Z; within-layer one-sided extrapolation explicitly labelled and limited to one nearest spacing

provenance.configuration_identity_definition: SHA256 of canonical JSON identity tuple; this is not a fabricated per-case configuration file
provenance.raw_export_source_label: Source that exported stored response; reused old carrier PDE is not counted as a new solve

probe_prediction.source_basis: 2000Hz output0 and2010Hz output1; caller-supplied actual 1Vpp high-Z solutions

coordinate_system.centre_pattern: Centre plus ±5 mm on x and y at each depth; centre offsets are distinct from 5 mm tip spacing

waveform_window.Vpp_definition: max(real summed carrier waveform)-min over the finite stated samples; sub-sample extrema are not solved
waveform_window.spectrum_definition: Coherent real-waveform DFT, peak phasor 2*FFT/N at2000/2010Hz; remaining-bin maximum retained
waveform_window.modulation_definition: 2min(abs(delta_phi_2000),abs(delta_phi_2010)); envelope depth, not a physical 10Hz voltage spectral component

instruments.status: User-supplied specifications and ideal gain bookkeeping only; actual settings unconfirmed
instruments.load_interpretation: ETA input specifications preserved as supplied; no input circuit assembled or R/C effects applied. Scope R/C belongs downstream of the active probe output.
instruments.scaling_definition: probe physical output=unloaded tip difference/physical attenuation; displayed voltage=probe output*selected scope display ratio

probe_prediction.interpolation_scope: Physical bilinear XY plus same-layer linear Z; within-layer one-sided extrapolation explicitly labelled and limited to one nearest spacing

provenance.material_version_if_absent: No separate version declared; use receipt SHA/schema
provenance.contact_version_if_absent: No separate version declared; use receipt SHA/schema
provenance.configuration_identity_definition: SHA256 of canonical JSON identity tuple; this is not a fabricated per-case configuration file
provenance.raw_export_source_label: Source that exported stored response; reused old carrier PDE is not counted as a new solve

coordinate_system.centre_pattern: Centre plus ±5 mm on x and y at each depth; centre offsets are distinct from 5 mm tip spacing

waveform_window.Vpp_definition: max(real summed carrier waveform)-min over the finite stated samples; sub-sample extrema are not solved
waveform_window.spectrum_definition: Coherent real-waveform DFT, peak phasor 2*FFT/N at2000/2010Hz; remaining-bin maximum retained
waveform_window.modulation_definition: 2min(abs(delta_phi_2000),abs(delta_phi_2010)); envelope depth, not a physical 10Hz voltage spectral component

instruments.status: User-supplied specifications and ideal gain bookkeeping only; actual settings unconfirmed
instruments.load_interpretation: ETA input specifications preserved as supplied; no input circuit assembled or R/C effects applied. Scope R/C belongs downstream of the active probe output.
instruments.scaling_definition: probe physical output=unloaded tip difference/physical attenuation; displayed voltage=probe output*selected scope display ratio

probe_prediction.interpolation_scope: Physical bilinear XY plus same-layer linear Z; within-layer one-sided extrapolation explicitly labelled and limited to one nearest spacing

waveform_window.spectrum_definition: Coherent real-waveform DFT, peak phasor 2*FFT/N at2000/2010Hz; remaining-bin maximum retained
waveform_window.modulation_definition: 2min(abs(delta_phi_2000),abs(delta_phi_2010)); envelope depth, not a physical 10Hz voltage spectral component

instruments.status: User-supplied specifications and ideal gain bookkeeping only; actual settings unconfirmed

instruments.scaling_definition: probe physical output=unloaded tip difference/physical attenuation; displayed voltage=probe output*selected scope display ratio

probe_prediction.interpolation_scope: Physical bilinear XY plus same-layer linear Z; within-layer one-sided extrapolation explicitly labelled and limited to one nearest spacing

probe_prediction.source_basis: 2000Hz output0 and2010Hz output1; caller-supplied actual 1Vpp high-Z solutions

coordinate_system.centre_pattern: Centre plus ±5 mm on x and y at each depth; centre offsets are distinct from 5 mm tip spacing

waveform_window.Vpp_definition: max(real summed carrier waveform)-min over the finite stated samples; sub-sample extrema are not solved
waveform_window.spectrum_definition: Coherent real-waveform DFT, peak phasor 2*FFT/N at2000/2010Hz; remaining-bin maximum retained
waveform_window.modulation_definition: 2min(abs(delta_phi_2000),abs(delta_phi_2010)); envelope depth, not a physical 10Hz voltage spectral component

instruments.status: User-supplied specifications and ideal gain bookkeeping only; actual settings unconfirmed
instruments.load_interpretation: ETA input specifications preserved as supplied; no input circuit assembled or R/C effects applied. Scope R/C belongs downstream of the active probe output.
instruments.scaling_definition: probe physical output=unloaded tip difference/physical attenuation; displayed voltage=probe output*selected scope display ratio

probe_prediction.interpolation_scope: Physical bilinear XY plus same-layer linear Z; within-layer one-sided extrapolation explicitly labelled and limited to one nearest spacing
